title: Complex & Fraction Types

tasks.description: Implement Complex class - create Complex number class with re, im properties, implementing IComplex interface with proper immutability
Complex arithmetic operations - implement add, subtract, multiply, divide methods with proper complex number math
Complex transcendental functions - implement exp, log, sqrt, pow, sin, cos, etc. for complex numbers
Implement Fraction class - create exact rational number representation with numerator/denominator as bigint
Fraction arithmetic with GCD - implement add, subtract, multiply, divide with automatic reduction using GCD
BigNumber integration - pure TypeScript implementation using bigint for arbitrary precision decimals
Write comprehensive tests - test all type operations including edge cases, precision, and conversions

successCriteria: Complex transcendental functions pass accuracy tests
Fraction automatically reduces to lowest terms
notes: Sprint 2 implements the fundamental numeric types beyond plain numbers. Complex provides complex arithmetic, Fraction provides exact rationals using bigint, and BigNumber provides arbitrary precision decimals using pure TypeScript (no external dependencies like decimal.js). All 190 tests passing.
